steps.error: Could not query the Chrome UX Report. Check the API key is valid and the Chrome UX Report API is enabled on its Google Cloud project.
The sitemap could not be read or lists no pages. Check the Sitemap URL opens in a browser and is plain XML, not gzipped. Sites that block cloud servers need the data source added via a relay agent.

The Chrome UX Report holds no data for the sitemap's website yet. Sites only appear once they have enough real Chrome traffic, so tiles stay empty until then. If your sitemap is hosted on a CDN, this warning is expected and safe to ignore.
steps.success: Chrome UX Report data found for this website.
